title: Local Fréchet Regression with Riemannian Predictors
summary: Fréchet regression is well developed for Euclidean predictors, but local linear methods remain limited for general manifold-valued predictors. We propose local constant and local linear estimators for predictors lying on a general Riemannian manifold and responses taking values in a general metric space. The proposed local linear estimator is the first local linear Fréchet regression method in this setting.
